rules.statement: A parent donates property to his child such a gift may be accepted on behalf of the child by a person authorised by the parent to accept the gift. There must also be the intention on the part of the parent to divest himself of the property in favour of the child with some kind of solemnity indicating to all concerned the exact nature of the transaction.
